metadata.title: What Wave–Particle Duality Actually Means
metadata.thing: the possibility wave replacing the ball-with-ripples cartoon
chapters: What we skipped, and your turn
metadata.long_title: What Wave–Particle Duality Actually Means — it's not a ball with ripples | Bear's Notes
metadata.description_blurb: In this video: why the ball-with-ripples cartoon is dimensionally impossible (the wave of a lab electron is tens of thousands of times wider than the 'ball' could be); two questions that get two different answers — stripes for 'how do you travel?', one whole dot for 'where are you?'; why 'secret route' and 'wave of stuff' both fail; the one honest picture — a wave of possibility, |ψ|²; and duality's real meaning: wave-shaped possibilities, particle-shaped results.
metadata.short_blurb: Duality without the ball-with-ripples cartoon. Full explainer on the channel.

What Wave–Particle Duality Actually Means
beats.tts_normalized_text:

What Wave–Particle Duality Actually Means.
beats.new_visual_element: Title card: 'Bear's Notes' small, title large in EB Garamond, thin brown rule, small blue accent mark on dark canvas.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Fade in series line, Write the title, brown underline, blue tick. Hold.

beats.narration_text: Ask anyone to draw an electron and you'll get the same cartoon: a little ball with ripples around it.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Ask anyone to draw an electron and you'll get the same cartoon: a little ball with ripples around it.
accumulated_scene_state: brown ball with concentric ripples, center of MAIN
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] The popular cartoon: a brown ball at center with concentric secondary ripple circles around it.
beats.video_animation_prompt: GrowFromCenter the ball; Create three ripple circles around it.

beats.narration_text: It feels perfect — a solid particle core wearing a wavy coat.
beats.tts_normalized_text: It feels perfect — a solid particle core wearing a wavy coat.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Two small ink labels: 'the core' pointing at the ball, 'the coat' at the ripples — placed in clear space left of the cartoon.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write both labels with thin pointer lines; brief hold.

beats.narration_text: But measure both parts: a lab electron's ripples span a tenth of a nanometer, while the ball would be tens of thousands of times smaller.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But measure both parts: a lab electron's ripples span a tenth of a nanometer, while the ball would be tens of thousands of times smaller.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] A brace spans the ripples labeled '0.167 nm' (blue); beneath the ball a tiny tick labeled '÷ 60,000' (ink) — the dimensional mismatch.
beats.video_animation_prompt: GrowFromCenter brace + write 0.167 nm; tick + ÷ 60,000 label at the ball.

beats.narration_text: The coat is a stadium and the ball is a grain of dust — this cartoon cannot be the thing.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The coat is a stadium and the ball is a grain of dust — this cartoon cannot be the thing.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] The cartoon dims; a single highlight '?' beside it.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Cartoon to 40% opacity; FadeIn '?', Indicate.

beats.narration_text: So interrogate the electron itself, with two different questions.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So interrogate the electron itself, with two different questions.
accumulated_scene_state: compact lab: gun, two slits, screen
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Fresh canvas. A compact version of the concept-#3 lab builds: gun, two-slit barrier, screen — the interrogation room.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create compact gun/barrier/screen in MAIN.

beats.narration_text: Ask "how do you travel?" — send many through two slits — and the answer comes back striped, the signature of a wave.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Ask "how do you travel?" — send many through two slits — and the answer comes back striped, the signature of a wave.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A quick flurry of faint streaks crosses; the blue striped curve draws along the screen; small ink label 'how do you travel? → stripes' top-left.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Lagged faint streaks; Create striped curve; write the Q1 label top-left.

beats.narration_text: Ask "where are you?" — put up a screen — and each answer is one whole dot, never half an electron, never a smear.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Ask "where are you?" — put up a screen — and each answer is one whole dot, never half an electron, never a smear.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] One blue electron flies and lands as a single whole ink dot; label 'where are you? → one whole dot' joins beneath the first label.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Single flight to a bright band; dot lands; write Q2 label under Q1.

beats.narration_text: Try the story "it's really a particle with a secret route" — then two slits should give two heaps, and they don't.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Try the story "it's really a particle with a secret route" — then two slits should give two heaps, and they don't.
accumulated_scene_state: brown dashed two-heap curve, struck through
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A brown dashed two-heap curve appears at the screen — the secret-route prediction — then a hairline strike crosses it.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create dashed heaps; diagonal strike; both drop to low opacity.

beats.narration_text: Try the story "it's really a spread-out wave of stuff" — then a detector should sometimes catch a fraction, and it never does.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Try the story "it's really a spread-out wave of stuff" — then a detector should sometimes catch a fraction, and it never does.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A half-dot (semicircle) glyph appears near the screen — the fractional-detection prediction — and is struck through.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn semicircle glyph; strike; both to low opacity.

beats.narration_text: Both comfortable stories fail: the electron is neither a tiny marble nor a material ripple.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Both comfortable stories fail: the electron is neither a tiny marble nor a material ripple.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Both struck glyphs fade away; a beat of stillness on the clean lab.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeOut both struck items; brief hold.

beats.narration_text: Here is the honest picture: between the gun and the screen there is one object — a wave.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Here is the honest picture: between the gun and the screen there is one object — a wave.
accumulated_scene_state: blue wave packet traveling across the lab
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] A clean blue wave packet (gaussian-envelope wiggle) appears at the gun and glides toward the barrier — the ONE object.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create packet at left; animate it gliding rightward toward the slits.

beats.narration_text: That wave is not electron-stuff smeared through space; it is a map of possibility — brighter means more likely.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That wave is not electron-stuff smeared through space; it is a map of possibility — brighter means more likely.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] SIDE: 'a map of possibility' writes, and beneath it MathTex |ψ|² — the map's name (recalled from the last video).
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write side line; Write |\psi|^2 in the side eq row.

beats.narration_text: The dot is not the wave shrinking back into a ball; it is the answer you forced by asking where.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The dot is not the wave shrinking back into a ball; it is the answer you forced by asking where.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] The packet reaches the screen; a single whole dot appears in a bright band and the packet fades — answer, not shrinkage.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Packet glides to the screen; dot pops with a small flash; packet fades out.

beats.narration_text: That is all duality means: wave-shaped possibilities, particle-shaped results — one object, two kinds of question.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That is all duality means: wave-shaped possibilities, particle-shaped results — one object, two kinds of question.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] SIDE: the endpoint definition writes on two lines — 'wave-shaped possibilities' / 'particle-shaped results'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write the two definition lines in the side card row.

beats.narration_text: Now repair the cartoon: erase the little ball, keep the wave — and let the dot exist only at the moment of arrival.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now repair the cartoon: erase the little ball, keep the wave — and let the dot exist only at the moment of arrival.
accumulated_scene_state: ball fades, ripples morph into a packet
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] The hook's ball-with-ripples returns, small; the ball fades away and the ripples morph into a clean blue packet — the repaired picture.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn small cartoon; FadeOut ball; ReplacementTransform ripples → small packet.

beats.narration_text: The electron isn't sometimes a wave and sometimes a particle; it is always the wave in between, and always a whole dot when asked.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The electron isn't sometimes a wave and sometimes a particle; it is always the wave in between, and always a whole dot when asked.
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] The repaired packet glides once more and ends as a single whole dot at the screen — the full story in one motion.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Packet glides right; dot pops at screen; packet fades.

beats.narration_text: The sizes make it vivid: that wave spans zero point one six seven nanometers — atom-spacing scale, exactly why crystals can reveal it.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The sizes make it vivid: that wave spans zero point one six seven nanometers — atom-spacing scale, exactly why crystals can reveal it.
accumulated_scene_state: scale card: λ = 0.167 nm ≈ atom spacing
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF·NUMBER] The side column clears; a scale card writes: MathTex λ = 0.167 nm with 'atom-spacing scale' beneath.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeOut side content; write λ line + subtitle in the freed side column.

beats.narration_text: And between your questions the wave is the only thing evolving — every chip and laser is engineered by computing the wave, never by tracking little balls.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And between your questions the wave is the only thing evolving — every chip and laser is engineered by computing the wave, never by tracking little balls.
accumulated_scene_state: side line: chips & lasers run on the wave
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] Below the scale card: 'chips & lasers are built on the wave' (secondary).
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write the engineering line beneath; brief hold.

beats.narration_text: We haven't yet written the wave down, normalized it, or found its equation of motion — that's the next two videos.
beats.tts_normalized_text: We haven't yet written the wave down, normalized it, or found its equation of motion — that's the next two videos.
